_doc: Băng Tâm Các tier C (and four Kết Đan elders): the inner and outer gates, the halls' juniors, the Desert Pavilion. World-depth pilot, part 2.

people.role: Captain of the Desert Pavilion's guard
people.backstory: A salt-boiler's son from Chử Diêm Thôn who rides the caravan road for Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc) and has buried more Dạ Quang raiders than he can count.

ties.note: her right hand at the Desert Pavilion
the outer boy who calls him captain
caravan rider of the Desert Pavilion's guard
desert-born guard of the Desert Pavilion who passed the Frost Test on his third sitting

tree.intent: Earth wards and health: a caravan wall.

build.note: A shield on the desert road.

people.role: Keeper of the burial glacier above the seat
people.backstory: She keeps the glacier where the Pavilion's dead stand facing south and knows every name in it; she climbs halfway up Băng Bích Nhai once a year and leaves a lamp for Cố Lăng Sương (co_lang_suong).

ties.note: the lamp each year
her niece and disciple
cuts the standing graves in the burial glacier

people.role: Treasurer of the Pavilion; counts the frost coast's tax
people.backstory: The Pavilion's treasurer has noticed that the frost coast's tax books never quite agree with the fish markets', and suspects Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang) without being able to prove it.

ties.note: suspects the two sets of books
his clerk
the steward who fights him over the bills
tax-reckoner of the Hall of Cold Law on the frost coast

build.note: A ledger with a sword hidden in it.

people.role: Master of the Pavilion's skiffs on the frost coast
people.backstory: He raided Hàm Nguyệt's pearl beds at twenty in the Long Lake War (A013) and has wanted another war ever since; the frost coast's skiffs answer to him and to Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang). His captains on the lake's north shore lend the villages silver for Sương Tùng's wall lanterns at a fish in five, so the shore owes the Pavilion, not the pines.

ties.note: backs him for heir
Hàm Nguyệt's mistress, whose beds he raided in 942; since 1152 he leaves her north beds alone for one pearl in ten
Tùng Đào's Lake Warden; they count each other's boats across the lake
skiff disciple who carries the Hall of Cold Law's letters along the frost coast
ice-hole fisher and skiffman on the frost coast
Sương Tùng's paper-mistress; his captains paid her ahead for forty wall lanterns, and the last of them are owed before the thaw

tree.intent: Water damage and health; a boarding fighter.

build.note: A boathook spear and a short temper.

people.changed: fix pass A: gear + phi_kiem (a kiem_tu wears a sword)

people.role: Tiết Hàn Mai's disciple in the Array
people.backstory: The only disciple Tiết Hàn Mai (tiet_han_mai) has let walk the Array's outer nodes; she is careful enough, Tiết thinks, and has not yet been told so.

ties.note: Array Hall junior
Array Hall disciple who checks the lid stones of the Jade Vessel Array

tree.intent: Formation power through Water and Earth.

build.note: The Array's next keeper, if there is time.

people.role: Inner disciple of the burial glacier
people.backstory: Raised by her aunt Nhạc Băng Thiềm (nhac_bang_thiem) among the standing dead, she talks to them more easily than to the living.

ties.note: her aunt

people.role: Khương Lưu Ly's disciple
people.backstory: From the ice-hole village of Băng Khổng Thôn, she worships her master Khương Lưu Ly (khuong_luu_ly) and despises everyone who backs the frost-coast man for heir.

people.role: Senior sword of the Plum Sword Hall, passed over for Hạ Lăng Hàn
people.backstory: Phó Ám Hương (pho_am_huong) taught him the Snow Plum for forty years and then made the newcomer Hạ Lăng Hàn (ha_lang_han) his true disciple; Tưởng trains until his hands bleed and says nothing.

ties.note: she got what he earned
Plum Sword Hall swordsman of Tưởng Hàn Phong's side

people.role: Rider of the Beast Hall
people.backstory: He rides a white-maned ice wolf from the den at Tuyết Hiêu Nguyên that Lam Tuyết Điêu (lam_tuyet_dieu) gave him; the wolf chose him, and the hall still argues about it.

ties.note: Beast Hall rider

people.role: Apprentice warden of the Ice Soul vein
people.backstory: From Kê Minh like her master Kha Tĩnh Ba (kha_tinh_ba), she keeps the vein's thunder log and has drawn the warming curve he will not show the seat.

ties.note: keeps the lightning rods on the Ice Soul vein

people.gloss: Snow (Âu Dương is a two-syllable surname)
people.role: Quartermaster of the seat and its mortal servants
people.backstory: He feeds four hundred people on a glacier without one open flame, and the treasurer Quách Lẫm (quach_lam) questions every bill he signs.

ties.note: the bills
his best servant
washer of the seat's undyed robes; Đào Hàn Mặc's mother

people.role: Keeper of the ice sables at the Beast Hall
people.backstory: She breeds the white sables whose fur lines every elder's sash, and nurses Lam Tuyết Điêu's (lam_tuyet_dieu) injured beasts in a hut warmed by qi.

ties.note: desert-born rider of the Beast Hall

people.role: Skiff captain on the frost coast
people.backstory: A cliff-village boy who steers Lục Hàn Chu's (luc_han_chu) fastest skiff and would row it into a storm if asked.

ties.note: skiff hand of the frost coast
skiff disciple who carries the Hall of Cold Law's letters along the frost coast
ice-hole fisher and skiffman on the frost coast

people.changed: fix pass A: gear + phi_kiem (a kiem_tu wears a sword)

people.role: Desert-born inner disciple at the Desert Pavilion
people.backstory: One of the handful of Hồi Lan's harbour children ever to pass the Frost Test, she serves Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc) and is quietly looked down on at the seat for her accent.

ties.note: Hồi Lan girl who passed the Frost Test; Giang Sương Lạc's disciple
keeps the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion

people.role: Banner-bearer of the Desert Pavilion guard
people.backstory: A Trường Vân magistrate's nephew who carries the white banner on the caravan road under Tôn Hàn Thạch (ton_han_thach), and has never let it touch sand.

ties.note: his cousin
caravan rider of the Desert Pavilion's guard

people.changed: cross-sect pass: tie to ha_lang_han sibling -> cousin (its own note said cousin).; fix pass A: gear + phi_kiem (a kiem_tu wears a sword)

people.role: Clerk of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
people.backstory: He writes the frost coast's judgements in a hand admired as far as the Pivot, and keeps Thẩm Hàn Giang's (tham_han_giang) second set of books without asking why.

ties.note: keeps the second books
the Lãnh Giang clerk who reads his books too closely
copyist of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
tax-reckoner of the Hall of Cold Law on the frost coast

build.note: A brush and a frost talisman.

people.role: The envoy's aide
people.backstory: She copies Ngụy Thanh Hàn's (nguy_thanh_han) letters and has started keeping copies of her own.

ties.note: the outer girl she pays for gossip

people.role: The treasurer's clerk
people.backstory: Born on the frost coast, she adds the coast's tax for Quách Lẫm (quach_lam) and has found the gap he is looking for; she has not decided whose side she is on.

ties.note: copyist of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang

people.role: Khương Lưu Ly's youngest disciple
people.backstory: A fisher's daughter who reached Foundation in record time and laughs in the halls, which her master Khương Lưu Ly (khuong_luu_ly) is trying, and failing, to cure.

ties.note: laughs at his songs
Tạ Ngân Sương's disciple

people.role: Frost-coast inner disciple, Thẩm's man
people.backstory: Liên Giang-born and proud of it, he organises the coast disciples who want Thẩm Hàn Giang (tham_han_giang) as Keeper and would follow Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) anywhere.

ties.note: an inner-gate rival
frost-coast inner disciple sent down from the seat after a quarrel

people.role: Warden of the burial glacier
people.backstory: He cuts the standing graves in the glacier for Nhạc Băng Thiềm (nhac_bang_thiem) and has noticed the ice near the vent is softer every year.

ties.note: cuts the standing graves in the burial glacier
the grave-cutter's son in the outer gate

people.role: Keeper of the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion
people.backstory: An oasis girl like Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc), she keeps Tần's cold well (A114) at the old seat and grows the only ice lilies in the desert in its overflow.

ties.note: same village
the outer girl she gives seeds
keeps the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion
her niece; Cát Ngọc Trì's niece at the Desert Pavilion

people.role: The outer disciple who reached Foundation without Ice
people.backstory: Five Frost Tests, five failures, and he reached Foundation on the Water primer alone, which no one had done; Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) argues for him every year, and the inner gate still says no.

ties.note: his advocate
oldest of the outer gate; failed three Frost Tests and stayed

build.note: A Water sword in an Ice house.

people.role: Thunder-scarred watcher of the Ice Soul vein
people.backstory: The vein's lightning took two fingers and half her meridians in 1188; Kha Tĩnh Ba (kha_tinh_ba) kept her on the watch when the seat would have sent her home.

ties.note: watcher of the Ice Soul vein; the warden's niece

people.role: Tea master of the seat
people.backstory: He warms the Pavilion's water with qi instead of fire and blends the pine tea Tiết Hàn Mai (tiet_han_mai) sends up the mountain; he has never asked who drinks it.

ties.note: the tea
tea servant who warms the seat's water with qi
his niece; the tea master's grandniece in the outer gate

people.role: Inner disciple born on the head's own peak
people.backstory: Born in a herders' camp on Băng Bích Nhai like the Keeper herself, she has the strongest Ice of her year and no love for the Pavilion; Nhạc Băng Thiềm (nhac_bang_thiem) took her in when no one else would.

build.note: A strong root with one foot out of the door.

people.role: The guest alchemist's apprentice
people.exception: R2: guest alchemist's apprentice, a Fire root kept outside the lineage
people.backstory: Viên Chước (vien_chuoc) bought him out of Hồng Lô Cốc's kitchens to tend the furnace at Hàn Giao Chử; he is the only warm thing at the Beast Hall the wolves like.

ties.note: his father, a servant at Hồng Lô
furnace boy of the guest alchemist's hall at Hàn Giao Chử
his sister; the head cook's daughter; keeps the broth pot at the furnace mouth

people.role: Plum Sword disciple who copies the red-ink manual
people.backstory: Phó Ám Hương (pho_am_huong) lets only her copy the Snow Plum manual, because her red ink never smudges.

ties.note: Plum Sword Hall disciple; grinds the red ink

people.role: Skiffman and diver for ice-pearls
people.backstory: He dives for the white pearls of the frost coast under Lục Hàn Chu (luc_han_chu) and sells a few on the side to Hồi Lan's merchants.

ties.note: outer disciple lent to the coast; dives for ice-pearls
Mạnh Triều Sương's nephew; a skiff boy

people.changed: fix pass A: gear + phi_kiem (a kiem_tu wears a sword)

people.role: A Tiêu-clan son in the outer gate
people.backstory: The Tiêu clan of Hòe Âm has sent its sons elsewhere since Lê Hoa Am turned one away (A110); this one came to the Pavilion's outer gate, and he befriended Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam).

ties.note: his cousin at Lê Hoa Am
his elder cousin, Tầm Kiếm's head
his grandfather, the Tiêu patriarch
his father
his sister; Tiêu-clan daughter; sits her first Frost Test at the coming solstice

people.role: Youngest of the outer gate
people.backstory: Seventeen and homesick, she sits next to Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam) on the lake because Hồ looks the warmest.

people.role: Fisher's son in the outer gate
people.backstory: From Ngân Ngư Thôn, he cuts fishing holes in the Frost Test lake when Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) isn't looking.

ties.note: she pretends not to see
an outer-gate friend
sits her third and last Frost Test at the coming solstice
his brother; Hầu Ngư's younger brother

people.role: Passed the Frost Test last solstice
people.backstory: Ice answered her at dawn on the lake beside Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi), who wept, which nobody at the Pavilion is supposed to do.

ties.note: Tạ Ngân Sương's disciple

people.role: Sở Hàn Y's first disciple
people.backstory: He chose Sở Hàn Y (so_han_y) as his master because she was the only one who did not try to impress him.

people.role: Outer disciple from the seal-hunters' village
people.backstory: She clubbed seals at Hải Báo Thôn before she could read, and wants the Beast Hall, not the sword; Lam Tuyết Điêu (lam_tuyet_dieu) has noticed.

ties.note: wants to be her disciple
seal-hunter's boy, new in the outer gate

people.role: Desert-born outer disciple at the Desert Pavilion
people.backstory: A camel town's smith's son whose Water barely passed the gate; Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc) took him for the forge work Trấn Sa Đường charges too much for.

ties.note: took him in
caravan guard in training under Úc Hoàng Sa
desert-born guard of the Desert Pavilion who passed the Frost Test on his third sitting

people.role: Three Frost Tests failed; leaving for Lãnh Giang Phái
people.backstory: She failed her third test this winter and has chosen the fishers of Lãnh Giang over the road, and told Hồ Tiểu Đàm (ho_tieu_dam) there is no shame in it.

ties.note: her cousin at Lãnh Giang's outer gate
sits her third and last Frost Test at the coming solstice

people.role: Tưởng Hàn Phong's disciple in the Plum Sword Hall
people.backstory: He has taken his master Tưởng Hàn Phong's (tuong_han_phong) grievance as his own and glares at Hạ Lăng Hàn across the sword hall.

ties.note: his master's grudge
Plum Sword Hall disciple; grinds the red ink

build.note: A young plum with a grudge.

people.role: Outer disciple from the oriole valley
people.backstory: From Hoàng Oanh Thôn where the orioles winter (A107), she writes bird poems on the lake ice and has a Wood root the Frost Test will never answer; Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) suspects she belongs at Thúy Vi.

ties.note: her teacher

build.note: A poet in the wrong sect.

people.role: Reed-marsh boy in the outer gate
people.backstory: From Lô Hoa Thôn's reed marsh (A134), he breathes the primer more slowly than anyone and Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi) thinks he may be the one who passes this year.

people.role: Outer disciple from the tide village
people.backstory: She sells the outer gate's gossip to whoever pays and has lately been paid by Vương Thanh Lẫm (vuong_thanh_lam).

ties.note: pays her for gossip

people.role: Waterfall village girl in the outer gate
people.backstory: The strongest Water root of the new intake, from Bộc Ngư Thôn; Khương Lưu Ly (khuong_luu_ly) has already asked about her.

ties.note: noticed by her

people.role: Outer disciple from the sail-watchers' village
people.backstory: He means to fail the Frost Test on purpose and go to Trạc Anh Đài, where his family's boats are, but has not told Đỗ Sương Nhi (do_suong_nhi).

ties.note: frost-coast boy in the outer gate

people.role: Desert Pavilion inner disciple
people.backstory: A Trường Vân caravan clerk's daughter who passed the Frost Test on her first try and chose to stay at the Desert Pavilion with Giang Sương Lạc (giang_suong_lac).

ties.note: Hồi Lan girl who passed the Frost Test; Giang Sương Lạc's disciple

people.role: Caravan guard's son in the outer gate
people.backstory: His cousins guard caravans for Trấn Sa Đường; he guards them for the Pavilion under Tôn Hàn Thạch (ton_han_thach) and thinks the Frost Test a waste of a good winter.

ties.note: his captain
his elder cousin at Trấn Sa

people.role: Outer disciple from Lịch Thanh Thôn
people.backstory: Quiet, and good with the ice-herb beds by the outer gate; Cát Ngọc Trì (cat_ngoc_tri) sends her seeds from the desert well.

ties.note: the seeds
Đàm Tĩnh Thạch's niece; wants the Array Hall

people.role: Mạc Ngưng Bích's disciple
people.backstory: He fights the frost-coast disciples whenever his master Mạc Ngưng Bích (mac_ngung_bich) frowns at them, and loses to Lưu Hàn Ngạn every time.

ties.note: frost-coast inner disciple sent down from the seat after a quarrel

build.note: A hothead in a cold hall.

people.role: Raft village girl, newest in the outer gate
people.backstory: She came down the river on her father's log raft from Phiệt Mộc Thôn and has not stopped talking since; Hầu Ngư (hau_ngu) taught her to fish through the lake.

people.role: The horse village's only Water root
people.backstory: Mã Minh Thôn's herders have sent one child to the Pavilion in a century, and he is it; his Water barely clears the gate, and he rides better than anyone at the Desert Pavilion. Ôn Sa Ngọc (on_sa_ngoc) keeps him there.

ties.note: his sister; stable servant at the Desert Pavilion; Mã Đông Lâm's sister

people.role: Beast Hall inner disciple
people.backstory: Found as a child in an ice sable's den near Tuyết Hiêu Nguyên, she was given to Diêu Hàn Đàm (dieu_han_dam), who raises sables and, it seems, sable girls.

ties.note: Beast Hall rider

people.role: Servant of the seat who cultivates by grace
people.exception: R2: servant (tạp dịch), no Water; allowed to breathe the primer by the quartermaster's grace
people.backstory: Born to the seat's servants and kept warm by nothing, he sweeps the Vessel Hall; Âu Dương Tuyết (au_duong_tuyet) lets him sit in on the primer, though it will never take.

ties.note: his master in all but name
furnace boy of the guest alchemist's hall at Hàn Giao Chử
his mother; washer of the seat's undyed robes; Đào Hàn Mặc's mother

people.role: Ice-hole village outer disciple
people.backstory: She sits the lake the old Hàn Giang way her grandmother taught her, which Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) recognised at once.

ties.note: he knows the old way
outer disciple with a faint Ice the lake has not yet woken

people.role: Liễu Ngư Ca's young cousin
people.backstory: He followed his cousin Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) from Liên Giang and does not know the family's secret; he thinks his cousin is simply the best man alive.

ties.note: his cousin

people.changed: cross-sect pass: tie to lieu_ngu_ca sibling -> cousin (its own note said cousin).
